turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:

She eats ___ apple. Step 1: I say "apple". Step 2: it starts with "a", a vowel sound. Step 3: so I use "an". She eats an apple.
Rule: a vowel sound gets "an"; other sounds get "a".
Right: I have a pen. Wrong: She eats a apple.
Your turn now. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
